g.text: Each compiled program is measured on 6 held-out maps × 4 frozen opponents × 2 seats (48 games).

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a535d

g.text: Lines join the same generation seed across checkpoints. Diamonds are means over every prescribed draw, including invalid outputs.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a535d

g.text: Missing outputs are never plotted as zeros: this figure requires both round 3 endpoints and the complete independent audit.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a535d

g.text: Descriptive results only; no significance claim. Fault-free or all-rest behavior alone does not establish strategic improvement.
Invalid authoring: zero yield, no game
